journal: Theor. Found. Chem. Eng. 37(1), 51-53 (translated from Teor. Osn. Khim. Tekhnol. 37(1), 54-57)
title_authors: Water Solubility of Carbon Dioxide under Supercritical and Subcritical Conditions; A. N. Sabirzyanov, R. A. Shagiakhmetov, F. R. Gabitov, A. A. Tarzimanov, F. M. Gumerov
experimental_method: Static method in a 96 cm3 constant-volume rocking autoclave; liquid sampled through a capillary at constant pressure into weighed ampoules, dissolved gas throttled off and its volume measured at 20 C, 760 mm Hg.
uncertainties_stated: overall relative error 3% in solubility; gas volume to 1 cm3; deadweight gauge accuracy class 0.02; agrees within 7% with King et al. at 25 C, 10 and 20 MPa
quality_remarks: Temperature scale and thermocouple accuracy not stated. Liquid sampling at 25 C 60 and 80 MPa and 50 C 80 MPa was difficult (CO2 denser than water) and no values are printed there. Single table; Fig. 2 and Eq. 2 are a correlation (not extracted).
not_extracted_tables: Fig. 2 / Eq. (2): similarity-theory correlation with fitted coefficients a0..a3 (model, derived)

row_counts.Table: printed 4 rows x 5 pressure columns, 17 values (3 cells blank); written 20 rows, 17 with value

extraction_notes: Text layer matched image in all 17 values. Matrix flattened to long form.
